title: Peruvian Beef Stir Fry
description: A keto Peruvian-inspired beef stir fry with a tangy and crunchy twist.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, heat the crumble beef fat over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef strips and cook to desired doneness, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add the Peruvian aji amarillo sauce and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the crunchy slaw and stir-fry seasoning, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
6. Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the tangy lime juice.
7. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the beef is coated in the sauce.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
10. Pair with a side of cauliflower rice or a keto-friendly side dish.
